question_text: A 55-year-old man presents to his physician complaining of pain. He states that in the morning he feels rather stiff and has general discomfort and pain in his muscles. The patient has a past medical history of diabetes and is not currently taking any medications. His temperature is 99.2°F (37.3°C), blood pressure is 147/98 mmHg, pulse is 80/min, respirations are 12/min, and oxygen saturation is 99% on room air. Physical exam demonstrates mild tenderness of the patient's musculature diffusely. The patient has 2+ reflexes and 5/5 strength in his upper and lower extremities. Laboratory values are notable for an elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate. Which of the following is the best next step in management?
